description: cert-manager.io/v1alpha3 Certificate is not served by its CRD (1 object). 1 object(s) written through this version: shop (1). Written by: flux. CRD certificates.cert-manager.io marks v1alpha3 served: false (it serves v1alpha2, v1), so the apiserver rejects these objects at v1alpha3. CRD versions are set by the add-on that ships the CRD, independent of Kubernetes 1.35. Objects: shop/legacy-tls. Fix: move these objects to cert-manager.io/v1; the apiserver rejects writes at v1alpha3. A named manager that no longer writes them keeps them listed through its managedFields entry until another manager takes over its fields or the entry is removed.

CRD certificates.cert-manager.io lists unserved version v1alpha3 in status.storedVersions. Objects may still be persisted at v1alpha3, which CRD certificates.cert-manager.io no longer serves (storage version: v1). A CRD update that drops v1alpha3 from spec.versions is rejected while status.storedVersions lists it, so the add-on upgrade that drops it fails. CRD versions are set by the add-on that ships the CRD, independent of Kubernetes 1.35. Fix: migrate every stored Certificate to the storage version v1 (kube-storage-version-migrator, the add-on's own tool such as cert-manager's cmctl upgrade migrate-api-version, or a no-op update of each object), then remove v1alpha3 from status.storedVersions (kubectl patch crd certificates.cert-manager.io --subresource=status).

Written by: argocd-controller, kubectl-client-side-apply. CRD certificates.cert-manager.io marks v1alpha2 deprecated. The CRD says: "cert-manager.io/v1alpha2 Certificate is deprecated in v1.4+, unavailable in v1.6+; use cert-manager.io/v1 Certificate". Objects may still be stored at v1alpha2 (status.storedVersions). CRD versions are set by the add-on that ships the CRD, independent of Kubernetes 1.35. Objects: default/api-tls, shop/web-tls. Fix: move these objects to cert-manager.io/v1 before an add-on upgrade stops serving v1alpha2.
